prompts.prompt-r2.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of the Cíes Islands near Vigo, Galicia, Spain AT NIGHT. It is the middle of the night: the beach of Rodas is lit ONLY by moonlight, with a starry dark sky and a full moon. The white-sand beach of Rodas curves between the islands as a pale arc; the Atlantic water is dark with a silver moon reflection; green island ridges rise on both sides as dark silhouettes. Absolutely no daylight, no sun, no bright blue daytime sky anywhere. Main subject centered to survive a 4:5 center crop. No identifiable people, no legible logos, no text, lettering or signs anywhere in the image. Keep the lower third clean and uncluttered.
